"'''Tenoo's Fastest / Home Sweet Temple'''" is the fifteenth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[March 19]], [[2025]].

{{Media-stub}}

==Official description==
''Nash helps a racer. Kai must team up with a thief.''
